name: run_plan
description: Code Mode v1: run a bounded list of existing tools in one call. Input: {"steps":[{"tool":"read_file","args":{...}}, ...]}. Max 12 steps (16 ceiling). Cannot call run_plan or chain. Returns {ok:true,steps:[{tool,ok,error?,text}]}; a step's ok is false when that tool reported ok:false, and text is that tool's own JSON response verbatim.
llm_description: Run several catalog tools in one turn. Input: {steps:[{tool, args}]}. Max 12 steps. Use this instead of many round trips when the sequence is already known. A step reports ok:false when that tool failed; text carries its response verbatim. Do not nest run_plan or chain.
